evidence.content: Massive explosion reported at Port of Singapore. Terminal completely offline. Looks catastrophic. #SupplyChain #Disaster
Vessel traffic velocity entering Port of Singapore sector has dropped by 80% over the last 15 minutes. Multiple vessels entering holding patterns.
IMAGE_SPEC: drone_terminal_smoke.png. DESCRIPTION: A blurry overhead view showing dark black smoke billowing from the eastern edge of the port terminal.
STATUS UPDATE: Port operations temporarily paused in Eastern Sector for safety assessment. Emergency services dispatched.
BREAKING: Singapore port faces catastrophic disruption. Industry analysts predict 3 weeks of backlog. Global shipping stocks plummeting.
Spot freight rates for Asia-Europe routes have surged by 400% in the last 20 minutes.
IMAGE_SPEC: sat_high_res_thermal.png. DESCRIPTION: High-resolution thermal scan shows the main terminals are undamaged. The fire is isolated to a single independent chemical warehouse 3 miles inland.
WIND SHIFT ALERTS: 40-knot coastal winds blowing directly westward from the inland industrial park over the main port terminal.
STATUS UPDATE: Inland warehouse fire extinguished. No damage to port infrastructure. Smoke cleared. Full terminal operations resuming in 60 minutes.
